name: nexus
description: The most complete open-source AI coding agent engine — multi-engine, multi-agent, adaptive learning, research-backed prompt optimization, full MCP integration.
author: Darknode-Official

scripts.test: node --test test/run.js test/ui.test.js test/tokensave/ test/codegraph/ test/sectools/ test/perf/ test/patch/
scripts.test:verbose: node --test --test-reporter=spec test/run.js test/ui.test.js test/tokensave/ test/codegraph/ test/sectools/ test/perf/ test/patch/
scripts.lint: for f in src/*.js src/*/*.js index.js; do node -c "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'All files valid'
scripts.stats: echo "$(find src -name '*.js' | wc -l) modules, $(find src -name '*.js' | xargs cat | wc -l) lines" && npm test 2>&1 | grep '# pass'
